entities.name: Reveka
entities.description: Sea Dwarf Wizard Savant and Director of the Wizards' School on the Floating Island, a determined and manipulative political player.

entities.name: Wizards' School
entities.description: School of wizards on the Floating Island that Reveka directs.

entities.name: Floating Island
entities.description: Island home of the Wizards' School.

entities.name: Clan of the Gentle Wave
entities.description: Sea Dwarf clan Reveka grew up in.

entities.name: Council of Wizards
entities.description: Council ruling the Floating Isle that Reveka balances.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Nation whose warships Reveka keeps out of the waters.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Ruler who could go to war with Aysen.

entities.name: Eron the Relentless
entities.description: Threat who might economically destroy the school.

entities.name: Kerselin
entities.description: Place whose inhabitants Reveka brought food to.

events.summary: Reveka wins the position of Wizard Savant from the previous holder in an astronomy riddle contest, in under an hour.
events.quote: the young Sea Dwarf woman won the contest in less than an hour

events.summary: Reveka travels to seek alliances and sails food through winter storms to Kerselin.
events.quote: She even personally sailed a ship through the winter storms to bring food to the inhabitants of Kerselin .

relations.quote: Reveka is the current Wizard Savant and Director of the Wizards' School
she is the great-grandniece of Irini

relations.note: Grew up on one of its ships.
relations.quote: Having grown up on one of the ships of the Clan of the Gentle Wave
economically destroyed by Eron the Relentless at worst
